meta.name: data-modeling
meta.description: Designs the warehouse and semantic layer — source-to-mart structure, dimensional modeling, grain, slowly changing dimensions, and the metric layer analytics reads through. Use this to design or restructure a warehouse, model a new source, decide on grain or table structure, build a semantic or metric layer, or diagnose why queries are slow, wrong, or impossible to write.

copy.tagline: 设计支撑业务分析的数据模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责搭建或重构公司的数据仓库。
copy.tagline_en: Design a data warehouse model that supports analytics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for building or redesigning a company's data warehouse.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Raw/Staging/Marts 三层来设计数仓和语义层:给表定粒度、区分事实/维度、处理缓慢变化维度,并在 Marts 之上统一定义指标;也能诊断查询慢或结果错是否由粒度/分区/业务逻辑错层引起。
howto.when: 当你想设计或重构数仓、建模新数据源,或处理粒度/表结构/语义层等问题时会触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个订单数据建模,先定每张表的粒度。
say.note: Claude 会从 grain 开始设计表结构。

say.text: 我们的报表数字偏高,帮我查一下是不是 join 导致 fan-out。
say.note: 会先检查粒度,再查逻辑。

say.text: 在 marts 上搭一个统一语义层,把收入指标定义一次。
say.note: 之后各报表都读同一指标,避免口径漂移。

howto.what_en: Claude designs warehouses and semantic layers across Raw/Staging/Marts: it sets grain per table, separates facts from dimensions, handles slowly changing dimensions, and defines metrics once above marts. It can also diagnose slow or wrong queries via grain, partitioning, or misplaced business logic.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design or restructure a warehouse, model a new source, or handle grain/table-structure/semantic-layer issues.

say_en.text: Help me model this order data; first set the grain for each table.
say_en.note: Starts with grain before table structure.

say_en.text: Our report numbers are too high. Check whether a join causes fan-out.
Build a unified semantic layer above marts and define revenue once.
say_en.note: All dashboards then read the same metric.
